title: West Oxfordshire and Cotswold District Councils - Summarising planning engagement upfront
summary: West Oxfordshire and Cotswold councils report that AI tagging and summaries in Konveio and Go Vocal cut planning officers' repetitive administrative time by an estimated 85%.
account: West Oxfordshire District Council and Cotswold District Council used £280,000 of PropTech funding from the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government to develop tools with Konveio and Go Vocal that tag and summarize planning-consultation feedback. A case study of 12 August 2024 on the ministry's Local Digital site compares a West Oxfordshire consultation of August to October 2023 with a Cotswold consultation of February 2022. It reports that the AI tools could save an average of up to 85 percent of officer time. After the pilot the tools were made available to all departments, and Konveio and Go Vocal added them to their standard products. In a Local Government Association case study of 19 February 2025, the councils report an estimated 85% reduction in repetitive planning-administration time and say that teams are actively using the systems. They add that full integration into routine work may take time.
purpose: Tag and summarize consultation responses to reduce repetitive planning-administration work.
system: Konveio and Go Vocal AI tagging and generative summarization tools
model_version: OpenAI GPT model integrated into Konveio (version not stated)
deployer: West Oxfordshire District Council and Cotswold District Council

data.answer:
West Oxfordshire and Cotswold report 85% less repetitive planning-administration time with AI tagging and summaries of consultation feedback.

The estimate concerns a task subset, not the entire planning process or budget. The article gives no sample, timing method, or assessment of whether summaries preserve minority views and important objections. More consultation responses came from the earlier engagement platform and cannot all be attributed to the AI analysis tools.
